command.abortCommit: Generate Commit Message with TokenRhythm - Stop
config.title: TokenRhythm Copilot
config.commitLanguage.desc: Language for generated Git commit messages. When set to "auto", the language is detected from recent commit history. Defaults to English if no history exists.
config.commitLanguage.auto.desc: Auto-detect language from recent commit history (defaults to English)
config.commitModel.desc: Model ID used for commit message generation.
config.commitMessagePrompt.desc: Custom system prompt for commit message generation.
config.requestTimeout.desc: Maximum time (in milliseconds) for a single request. Default: 600000 (10 minutes). Increase if you encounter timeout errors with long responses.
config.recentCommitsCount.desc: Number of recent commits to analyze for style reference when generating commit messages. Set to 0 to disable. Default: 10.
config.commitIncludeCommitDiff.desc: When enabled, include the actual code changes (diff) of recent commits in the style reference, helping the model generate messages that better match the project's commit style. Default: false.
config.commitAttachContextFiles.desc: When enabled, attach the content of AGENTS.md and README.md from the repository root as additional context for commit message generation, helping the model better understand the project. Default: true.
config.modelPreset.desc: Current model preset ID. Use the 'Set Model Preset' command to select a preset. Set to 'custom' to use manual values from 'tokenrhythm.temperature' and 'tokenrhythm.top_p'.
config.temperature.desc: Model temperature (0.0 - 2.0). Paired with 'tokenrhythm.top_p'. Only used when 'tokenrhythm.modelPreset' is set to 'custom'.
config.top_p.desc: Model top_p (0.0 - 1.0). Paired with 'tokenrhythm.temperature'. Only used when 'tokenrhythm.modelPreset' is set to 'custom'.
config.enableAutoModelDiscovery.desc: Enable automatic model discovery. When enabled, the extension fetches the model list from the API and filters the model picker to show only models available on the server. Models not in the API list are hidden. New models on the server that are not in the built-in list are automatically added using metadata from models.dev — models that support reasoning get a thinking toggle (switchable), others keep thinking always on. Disable to see all built-in models regardless of API availability.
config.syncModelsOnStartup.desc: Check for new TokenRhythm models on startup, at most once per day. Sync results are reported as a single line in the "TokenRhythm" Output channel. Default: true.
config.maxInputTokensRatio.desc: Ratio of the real context window declared as maxInputTokens for each model (0.1 - 1.0, default 1.0). VS Code's agent auto-compaction triggers at ~90% of the declared maxInputTokens. **Recommended: 0.8** — this makes compaction fire at ~72% of the real window, preventing context overflow for BYOK models with very large windows (e.g. 1M tokens) where full declaration (1.0) would never trigger compaction. Does not affect the context_length sent in API requests, which always uses the real value.
config.modelPresets.desc: Model presets for quick selection via command palette. Each preset includes temperature and top_p. You can customize the presets.
config.modelPreset.id.desc: Preset identifier (must match the value in modelPreset setting).
config.visionProxyModel.desc: Vision model used by the ask_image tool to answer questions about attached images when the selected model does not support vision. The list here is static; **the dynamic model picker (command `TokenRhythm: Select Vision Proxy Model`) is authoritative** — it loads the latest vision-capable models from `/v1/models` (supports_vision=true). Use that command when new vision models are released.
config.visionProxyModel.enum.kimi-k2.7-c: Kimi K2.7 Code — vision-capable, no temperature/top_p.
config.visionProxyModel.enum.qwen3.8-max: Qwen3.8 Max — text + image input, 1M context.
config.visionProxyThinking.desc: Enable thinking/reasoning in the vision proxy model when answering image queries.
config.enableThirdPartyTokenIndicator.de: Enable the Advanced Token indicator in the status bar. The native Copilot token indicator always shows. When this is enabled, the extension also shows an advanced token counter in the VS Code status bar. Default: true.
config.apiMode.desc: API protocol used for chat requests. The platform supports OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic, and Responses API formats. Default: auto (follows each model's default format; in auto mode, models reporting supports_responses=true use the Responses protocol only when enableResponsesApi is on, otherwise they fall back to OpenAI).
config.apiMode.enum.auto.desc: Auto — use each model's default API format. Models that support the Responses API (supports_responses=true) use it only when the enableResponsesApi setting is enabled; otherwise they use the OpenAI-compatible format.
config.apiMode.enum.anthropic.desc: Anthropic — use the Anthropic format (POST /v1/messages). Note: some models have compatibility issues with the Anthropic protocol (e.g. DeepSeek forced thinking + temperature returns 400); the OpenAI-compatible format is recommended.
config.apiMode.enum.responses.desc: Responses — use the OpenAI Responses API format (POST /v1/responses). Only models with supports_responses=true support this protocol.
config.enableResponsesApi.desc: Use the Responses API protocol for models that support it (supports_responses=true, e.g. qwen3.7-max, deepseek-v4-flash-0731) when apiMode is set to auto. **Disabled by default** — the TokenRhythm Responses endpoint is still evolving (inconsistent stream event types across models, unstable tool calling, and non-standard multi-round tool backfill), so models default to the OpenAI-compatible format which is more mature. Enable this only if you want to try the Responses protocol.
config.enableAnthropicApi.desc: Use the Anthropic Messages protocol in auto mode for models detected as supports_anthropic=true at startup (from /v1/models — dynamic, no hardcoded model IDs). **Disabled by default** — the Anthropic endpoint has compatibility issues with some models (e.g. DeepSeek forced thinking + temperature returns 400), so the more mature OpenAI-compatible format is recommended. In auto mode, priority: Responses (if enabled) > Anthropic > OpenAI.
config.apiKeyMode.desc: API Key usage mode: rotation (round-robin across all keys, skipping unavailable ones) or single (only use the current key).
config.apiKeyMode.enum.rotation.desc: Round-robin across all API keys, automatically skipping unavailable ones.
config.apiKeyMode.enum.single.desc: Only use the currently selected API key.
config.singleKeyFallback.desc: Behavior when the current key is unavailable in single mode: error (report an error without switching) or switch (automatically switch to the next available key and show a notification).
config.singleKeyFallback.enum.error.desc: Report an error without switching to another key.
config.singleKeyFallback.enum.switch.des: Automatically switch to the next available key and show a notification in the bottom-right corner.
config.apiKeyRotationStatusCodes.desc: HTTP status codes that trigger automatic API key rotation (matched against [code] or status code in error messages). Default: [401, 402, 429, 503] — invalid key, insufficient balance, rate limit, and server busy all rotate to the next key.
config.apiKeyRotationErrorPatterns.desc: Error message text patterns that trigger automatic API key rotation (matched case-insensitively).
config.transientRetryStatusCodes.desc: HTTP status codes treated as transient platform errors (busy/rate-limited) that trigger whole-round auto-retry. When every key fails with one of these, the rotation loop backs off and retries automatically (see transientRetryTimes). Default: [429, 503].
config.apiKeyExhaustedCooldownMin.desc: Cooldown (minutes) for transiently exhausted keys (e.g. rate-limited with 429) before they can be reused. 0 = immediately reusable.
config.transientRetryTimes.desc: How many times to automatically retry the whole key-rotation round when every key fails with a transient error (429 rate limit / 503 server busy). Waits with exponential backoff (2s/4s/8s) between rounds and clears the transient cooldown before retrying. 0 = disable auto-retry.
config.balanceCheckEnabled.desc: Enable proactive balance pre-check via the tr_session cookie bound to each key. When a key's available balance is below minBalanceCny it is skipped automatically. Falls back to passive detection (402/401/429) when the cookie is missing or fails.
config.minBalanceCny.desc: Balance threshold (CNY): a key whose available balance is at or below this value is treated as exhausted and skipped. Set to a positive value to switch before balance hits zero.
config.balanceCheckIntervalSec.desc: Balance query cache TTL (seconds). The balance of the same cookie is cached for this duration to avoid hitting the user-center API too often. 0 = query every request.
